contender.error: PreflightError: execution lock not acquired within 1.0 s

label: SYNTHETIC INTEGRATION CHECK of the combined lock+sandbox route. Two independent TRUSTED SUPERVISORS; the lock is held OUTSIDE the sandbox and the sandboxed program never references it. NOT live model evidence, NOT a general concurrency or security theorem.
liveness_marker: written by the sandboxed program into its OWN run directory under the writable sandbox base -- the only place the profile permits. An earlier version had it write into the fixture work dir and the profile correctly DENIED that, which is containment working.
payload_construction_witness: sandbox_payload() executed OUTSIDE any sandbox with an in-memory open and a no-sleep stub: marker filename sandbox_active_<nonce>, contents <nonce>, no unresolved free name. Checking only that the FILENAME looked right is what hid the bug.
readiness_bound_to_this_run: the marker NAME carries a fresh per-run nonce and its CONTENTS must equal that nonce; any pre-existing marker bearing the nonce invalidates the observation. The earlier generic glob could have been satisfied by a stale or foreign run (root 2026-09-22 00:01).
root_diagnosed_the_failure: the prior payload interpolated the nonce into the FILENAME but emitted the bare name NONCE in .write(NONCE); the sandbox program has its own namespace and never defined it, so it died with NameError before the sleep. Rebuilt with repr-quoted literals binding NONCE as the first statement.
supersedes: COMBINED_LOCK_SANDBOX_RECEIPT.json, whose readiness used a generic base/p_*/sandbox_active glob a stale or foreign marker could satisfy. That receipt is PRESERVED unchanged with its attribution limit recorded.
topology: supervisor acquires lock -> launches sandbox program -> holds until it ends -> releases; contender attempts the same lock through the same wrapper
